title: The Regiment of Port Mahon
author: Odile Nystrom
blurb: Cyrus Almeida, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must choose which family member gets the last berth before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
